symptom: Hugging Face rejected the Xet upload token request with HTTP 403.
root_cause: The first HF_TOKEN lacked write permission for PiotrSty/sejm-speeches-corpus.
resolution: Replace the GitHub Actions secret with a scoped token granting write access to the target dataset.
regression_guard: Publication workflow fails closed when upload authorization is absent and exposes HF_TOKEN only to upload, verification metadata upload, and release tagging steps.
